settings.heading: Make it yours.
settings.subheadline: Custom photo luggage tags, designed by you, printed by us. Double-sided. Durable. Personal.

settings.heading: The Story
settings.body:
LOVELACE’D started with a school project and a Disney vacation. What began as a simple idea between a father and daughter became something bigger. A way to turn everyday items into something personal, something protected, something that’s unmistakably yours.

Every luggage tag is custom designed with your photo on the front and your details on the back. No templates. No mass production. Each one is reviewed and printed by hand.

settings.title: Upload Your Photo
settings.body: One photo. That’s all you need. A family shot, your pet, your kid’s favorite moment. We fit it to your luggage tag.

settings.title: Pick Your Style
settings.body: Choose a design preset for the back of your luggage tag. Bright, minimal, professional — whatever fits.

settings.title: Add Your Details
settings.body: Name, phone, email, address. You choose what goes on the back. Only what you want, nothing you don’t.

settings.title: We Review & Print
settings.body: Every order is personally reviewed for quality before we print. Double-sided on durable PVC. Then shipped to your door.

settings.title: It’s Personal
settings.body: Your photo. Your info. Your luggage tag. This isn’t a generic label. It’s something that’s unmistakably yours.

settings.title: It’s Protected
settings.body: Your details are stored securely as part of your order and used only for printing. We never share your data.

settings.title: It’s Reviewed
settings.body: No auto-production. Every design is personally checked before it’s printed. Quality is not optional.
